title: SkillLevelSettings
description: Skill levels per inhabitant (B5 part, TL #19589): every inhabitant has, per skill of the register, a start level (from the register's range) and a talent, both drawn once from the world seed; practice (skills/practice.json) adds gain x talent when an action finishes, up to max_level; gains not practised for a whole game day fade by forget_per_day. Values are placeholders until Marcel's word.

talent_min.description: Smallest talent: practice gain is multiplied by it.

forget_per_day.description: Practised level lost per game day (never below the start level).

max_level.description: Highest level a skill can reach.

retention.description: D1017 G2 (D1077): what long practice leaves. The highest gain ever reached (peak) and the number of game days practised are kept; forgetting never takes the gain below peak x floor_share_by_days(days), and practice while below the peak counts relearn_factor times (relearning is faster). Absent = no floor, no relearning bonus (as before).

floor_share_by_days.description: Points [days practised, share of the peak kept] with ascending days; linear in between, constant outside.

relearn_factor.description: Practice gain factor while the gain is below its peak (at least 1).
